Portfolio 3 is searching to build out it’s Operations team with a new Operations Manager to join the team and help strengthen our foundation. Heading into it’s 3rd year, the portfolio is looking to build an it’s initial success with CPHI Middle East, Umrah & Ziyarah Forum, and Saudi Maritime & Logistics Congress.

With some more exciting projects on the horizon you could be one of the key drivers in the next stage of bringing amazing experiences to, and forging memorable brands in, The Kingdom.

As Portfolio 3 is building and growing we are looking for someone to come and help specifically, but not limited to, the delivery of: The expanding Umrah & Ziyarah Forum ecosystem The evolving Innovation Driven Water Sustainability (IDWS) event after a successful 1st year.

The Operations Manager is responsible for the professional operational delivery of their allocated events; features and projects. You will ensure that all are delivered to the highest possible standards and to the satisfaction of all parties involved consistently throughout the year.

Reporting to the Head & Senior Operations Managers, the Operations Manager will be responsible together with the Senior Operations Manager for implementing the EMEA Operations objectives. The intention is for the Operations Manager to eventually take full lead on running these streams, with High Level Ministry involvement and communication required.

The Operations Manager should lead by example and demonstrate a professional responsibility to the department at all times. Adding value to the Operations Department and Portfolio alike and helping others to build their knowledge and ability for the future of Tahaluf.

Operational Duties Be the key point of contact for the show teams in all matters on your allocated shows, internal and external. Accountability for setting, regular forecasting & achieving operational show budgets for allocated events.

Responsibility for successful show management and technical delivery of several physical and digital events throughout the year including features & fully undertaking all related tasks.

Manage production and implementation of show project plans ensuring all operational tasks are carried out on a timely basis according to individual project plans and within deadlines across all your events. Ensuring all allocated events are working within the company’s H&S, Security & Sustainability guidelines at all times.

Implementation of internal and external Service Level Agreements on all allocated events. Oversee production and delivery of the show exhibitor manual. Communicate with suppliers to manage the brief, design, feature production and signage process in co-ordination with show teams and sponsors.

Communicate with suppliers and show teams to manage the brief, design, production and management of Registration areas and overall welcome experience. Compile post event reports and KPI analysis.

In collaboration with the Procurement team, monitor the ongoing performance of key contractors and troubleshoot / identify remedial action as required on each event.

Management Manage, mentor & develop line reports & others within the EMEA Operations team, You will manage line reports on a day to day basis where applicable, each of these may be allocated across multiple events throughout the year requiring you to work alongside other Operations Managers to effectively balance workloads & priorities for each team member individually.

Setting, monitoring and management of direct reports’ performance objectives and identifying training needs. Work with colleagues to achieve best practice in terms of operational planning and management.

Compliance / legal / H&S / Sustainability Adhere to all Informa compliance requirements and monitor supplier performance to ensure they are meeting our requirements.

Follow the complete HSS Operating Model for all allocated events, submitting paperwork as required in a timely and concise manner and embedding best practice & continual improvement’s into all your event planning. Collaborate with Informa H&S team to ensure suppliers meet and exceed our H&S requirements.

Work with H&S team on remedial measures where necessary. Be an active partner of the Informa Sustainability team and look for opportunities to support and enhance our sustainability initiatives.

Educated to degree level or equivalent  Qualities needed for the role  Strong and effective verbal and written skills in Arabic and English. 5 years of events or exhibition industry experience or similar. Must have independently and successfully managed operations on multiple large events to a consistently high standard.

Experience of managing, supporting & developing multiple line reports simultaneously. You will possess a good working knowledge of the exhibition industry & venues as well as a great working relationship with all official contractors.

Effective communication skills – being able to liaise with Operations team members as well as working with & reporting to Director Level individuals throughout the portfolio(s). Familiarity with good procurement practices . Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to inspire and motivate others, thinking outside the box for creative solutions.

Ability to anticipate problems and/or put contingency plans in place. A proven ability to work to tight deadlines, with attention to detail under pressure is a pre requisite. Willingness and ability to travel / work across differing time zones especially within the EMEA region. Proven knowledge of exhibition H&S Guidelines and implementation.
Computer literate and proficient in the use of commonly used business software and project management software .
IOSH Managing Safety Certificate (or equivalent) as a minimum.
Prior large budget management skill is a plus.
Please note this is a 9 month contract role. It can be performed remotely. We are not able to provide relocation or sponsorship support with the position. We work hard to make sure life at Tahaluf is rewarding, supportive and enjoyable for everyone. We’re not solely focused on a checklist of skills.

We champion energy and ambition and look for colleagues who will roll their sleeves up, join in and help make things happen. We don't just accept difference, we celebrate it. Tahaluf is the largest B2B live and on-demand events organiser in Saudi Arabia by space, attendance, colleagues, and revenue.

It is a joint venture between Informa PLC, the Saudi Federation for Cybersecurity, Programming and Drones (SAFCSP), and the Events Investment Fund (EIF). Tahaluf is bold, visionary, and determined to make an impact.

Our team fosters a culture of collaboration, creativity, and a little fun, here teamwork rules and work feels as exciting as the events we create.

Scaling at this pace also requires exceptional local partners, and Tahaluf is proud to work with a range of government and non-government organisations at the forefront of Saudi Arabia’s B2B and B2C large-scale events scene.

Be part of something BIG with Tahaluf’s series of record-breaking events: LEAP and Cityscape - the largest events in the world in their respective fields of tech and real estate; Black Hat MEA - a Guinness World Record holder for the largest CTF competition during the event; and CPHI Middle East - the largest pharma debut event in history, to name just a few.

Tahaluf is making a huge impact on the global events sector. Join our ambitious and highly committed team, unafraid to push boundaries and disrupt the status quo. From day one, you’ll dive into large-scale projects under the guidance of a supportive leadership team that will encourage your personal development and open doors to new opportunities.

Splunk is looking for a Marketing Operations Manager – Marketo Engineering who will be responsible for building, maintaining, and optimizing our Marketo instance. We're looking for someone who enjoys working with data, thrives on system integrations, and continuously looks for ways to improve marketing processes.

In this role, you'll partner closely with Marketing Strategy, Campaign Operations, Field Marketing, RevOps, Sales, and Data Analytics to deliver scalable, data-driven marketing technologies, processes, and workflows that help the business move faster!

Meet the Team Splunk is building a safer and more resilient digital world with an end-to-end platform designed for today's hybrid, multi-cloud environments. Leading organizations rely on our unified security and observability solutions to keep their systems secure, reliable, and available.

Our customers love our technology, but it's our people who make Splunk a great place to build a career! We believe great ideas come from diverse perspectives, collaboration, and a culture built on trust and kindness.

Bring your technical expertise, curiosity, and passion for solving sophisticated problems—and help organizations do their best work while growing your own career alongside a supportive team.

Your Impact As our Marketing Operations Manager – Marketo Engineering, you'll serve as the technical expert responsible for the health, scalability, and performance of our Marketo environment. You'll design and improve marketing automation capabilities, build efficient processes, and help teams execute campaigns with confidence.

Your work will directly improve operational efficiency, data quality, and marketing performance across the organization. You will:
Serve as the primary Marketo administrator, ensuring platform performance, governance, and operational excellence.
Build, maintain, and enhance scalable marketing automation programs and workflows.
Partner across Marketing, RevOps, Sales Operations, and Analytics to improve integrations, processes, and campaign execution.
Lead automation initiatives that increase efficiency, improve data quality, and enable measurable business outcomes.
Drive continuous improvements across the marketing technology ecosystem.

Administer the Marketo platform, including database health, email deliverability, campaign operations, and platform monitoring.
Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot integrations across Marketo and connected marketing technologies.
Automate recurring marketing processes using tools such as Openprise to improve efficiency and consistency.
Establish and maintain governance standards, including naming conventions, folder structures, documentation, and version control.
Partner with Marketing Strategy, Sales Operations, and Data teams to ensure reliable, scalable marketing processes.
Provide technical guidance and support for campaign execution, email templates, landing pages, forms, and related assets.
Design, build, and optimize Marketo campaigns, engagement programs, lead nurturing, segmentation, scoring models, and lifecycle programs.
Maintain a scalable architecture that supports future business growth.
Evaluate emerging marketing automation capabilities and recommend new tools or enhancements where appropriate.
Train and mentor stakeholders on Marketo best practices and platform capabilities.

The Library (PL) is a major national art research center serving the National Gallery's staff, fellows and professors at the Center for Advanced Study in the Visual Arts, visiting art historians, the scholarly community at large and members of the public.

The library contains a wide-ranging collection of more than 525,000 books and periodicals on the history, theory and criticism of art and architecture, millions of images and a broad range of electronic resources.

Duties for this position include: Coordinates and monitors Library-wide administrative operations: Coordinates and monitors administrative and operational processes that cut across the library's departments.

Maintains visibility into the status of key actions, deadlines and requirements related to travel, records, timekeeping, personnel-related documentation and other cross-department administrative workflows.

Reviews the status of ongoing actions, identifies delays, inconsistencies or incomplete documentation and follows up with supervisors, staff and other Gallery offices to keep processes moving accurately and on time.

Coordinates budget, procurement, contracts, and related financial operations: Coordinates Library-wide budget, procurement, contracts, and related financial processes involving federal, trust and grant funds. Tracks expenditures, commitments, purchase card activity, requisitions and supporting documentation.

Maintains and updates operational trackers, reports and related tools that support budget monitoring, purchasing and planning. Reviews transactions and documentation for completeness, correct coding, timeliness and alignment with established requirements. Identifies issues that require correction, clarification or further review.

Coordinates with procurement, budget, accounting, travel, contracting and related offices to support timely processing of Library business. Researches and develops practical approaches, models, and tools to support budget formulation, multi-year budget planning, and operational decision-making.

Analyzes workflows and recommends operational improvements: Reviews administrative workflows and recurring business processes to identify opportunities to improve efficiency, clarity, compliance and coordination across departments.

Develops and maintains shared procedures, checklists, templates, timelines and tracking tools that improve continuity and reduce confusion or duplication. Uses judgment in applying established guidance to specific situations.

Resolves routine process issues independently and recommends practical improvements or corrective actions when problems recur or existing procedures are not working effectively. Leads or coordinates Library wide operational planning efforts, including space planning, to assess near-term needs. Develops preliminary recommendations for implementation.

Coordinates personnel-related processes, workforce support activities, records management and operational planning: Coordinates and tracks administrative processes and documentation related to personnel actions, onboarding, awards, performance-related processes, training, professional development and other workforce support activities.

Helps identify recurring operational issues that affect staff effectiveness. Reviews and improves the onboarding process for new staff, using existing onboarding documentation as a starting point and doing further research to strengthen it.

Coordinates records management activities for administrative records, including file structures, retention practices and disposition processes. Works with Archives and Library staff to identify paper and electronic records that fall under the records schedule and helps sort and organize them appropriately.

Designs and carries out processes for digitizing administrative files. Creates and maintains tracking systems and documents procedures to improve consistency, access, and records control. Gathers, organizes and maintains information needed for internal reporting, operational planning and management decision-making.

Serves as a key operational point of contact: Serves as a regular point of contact for Library staff and for colleagues in administrative offices across the Gallery on matters related to Library operations and administrative processes.

Explains established procedures and requirements related to procurement, travel, records, timekeeping, budget tracking and related operational matters. Communicates clearly, professionally and with discretion, especially when handling sensitive or confidential information.
Specialized Experience Statement: Candidates must possess at least one year of specialized experience, equivalent in responsibility to the GS-07 level in the Federal service or private sector: Coordinating and monitoring administrative operations for an organization.

This experience must include: tracking business processes involving areas such as budget, procurement, travel, personnel actions, records, or other administrative functions; reviewing transactions, documentation, or requests for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with established procedures; maintaining reports, trackers, records, or other tools used to monitor deadlines, expenditures, commitments, or pending actions; identifying delayed, incomplete, or inconsistent actions and coordinating with staff or other offices to resolve them; and applying established guidance to resolve routine operational problems or recommend improvements to administrative processes.

One year at the GS-07 level is required to meet the time-in-grade requirements for the GS-08 level. You must meet all qualification and eligibility requirements by the closing date of this announcement.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

Comfrt is looking for a Sample Operations Manager to build, manage, and optimize our end-to-end sample operations process for all marketing samples.

You'll serve as the operational hub between Product Development, Merchandising, Creative, Marketing, Photography, Social Media, Operations, and overseas vendors, making sure every sample lands accurately and on time for development, photoshoots, campaigns, wear testing, executive reviews, and product launches.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is highly proactive, thrives in a fast-paced environment, builds scalable processes, and can independently manage competing priorities while holding the line on accuracy and urgency.

Sample Operations Management
Own the end-to-end sample lifecycle across all product categories and seasons.
Build and maintain a centralized sample management system that provides real-time visibility across the organization.
Manage all inbound and outbound creator photography, marketing, creative, executive, and wear-test samples.
Ensure all samples are accurately tracked from vendor shipment through internal distribution and return.
Develop standardized operating procedures for sample handling, tracking, storage, and distribution.
Continuously improve sample workflows to increase efficiency and reduce delays.
Maintain digital libraries of sample imagery and approvals for internal visibility.
Ensure all submissions are organized, documented, and easily accessible.
Sample Request & Calendar Management
Manage all sample requests across Product Development, Creative, Marketing, Merchandising, Social Media, Photography, Operations, and Executive Leadership.
Prioritize competing requests while ensuring critical business milestones are achieved.
Understand the seasonal marketing calendar and proactively plan sample requirements to support all campaigns, launches, photoshoots, creator partnerships, and key business initiatives.
Coordinate sample readiness to align with product launch calendars and cross-functional deadlines.
Creative & Photo Studio Partnership
Partner closely with Creative and Photography teams to coordinate samples for all photoshoots.
Assist with outfit planning, product assortment, styling coordination, and sample selection for creative shoots.
Ensure all photography samples are complete, organized, steamed, tagged, and delivered on schedule.
Coordinate sample returns and inventory reconciliation following photoshoots.
Vendor Communication
Serve as the primary operational contact for all sample-related communication with overseas vendors.
Manage daily communication through Email, WhatsApp, Slack, WeChat, and other communication platforms.
Follow up proactively on sample status, shipment timing, missing samples, and vendor action items.
Escalate risks early and drive timely resolutions to maintain business timelines.
Team Leadership & Development
Directly manage the Sample Coordinator, providing daily direction, coaching, training, and performance management.
Develop the Sample Coordinator's skills, knowledge, and career growth through regular feedback and development plans.
Establish team priorities and allocate workload to ensure all sample requests are completed accurately and on time.
Create clear processes, expectations, and accountability measures for the sample operations team.
Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, performance reviews, and ongoing coaching.
Identify opportunities to improve team efficiency through process improvements, automation, and better resource planning.
Foster a collaborative, proactive, and solutions-oriented team culture.
Build and scale the Sample Operations function as the business grows, recommending additional resources when needed.
Serve as the escalation point for complex sample issues, cross-functional conflicts, and vendor challenges.
Team & Cross-Functional Management
Coordinate sample activities across multiple departments to ensure alignment on priorities.
